meta.title: Easy Visa | Travel & visa services in Mukalla, Yemen
meta.description: Request Umrah, family visit and Oman visas, and book flights, land transport and hotels with Easy Visa in Mukalla, Hadhramaut. Send your request online and track it easily.

common.priceNote: Indicative price, confirmed when we review your request

home.passText: Enter your reference to see where it stands.
home.boardIntro: Pick a service, send the details in a few minutes, and our team follows up with you to the end.
home.promisesTitle: What you can expect from us
home.contactText: Ask us about any service before you request it. We reply on WhatsApp or by phone.
home.tripsText: Limited seats on fixed dates. Book early.

services.title: All services
services.intro: Visas and travel bookings, handled clearly from the first request to the last step.
services.requirementsNote: Official procedures can change; we confirm the final list when we review your request.
services.requestText: The form takes a few minutes. You get a reference number to track your request.
services.disclaimer: Easy Visa helps you prepare and follow up your request. We do not guarantee visa approval or booking availability; the final decision belongs to the authorities and providers.
services.empty: No published services in this category yet.

request.title: Request: {service}
request.intro: Fill in the details below. Our team contacts you after reviewing them.
request.fullNamePh: As in your passport, if possible
request.phoneHelp: Yemeni, Saudi and international numbers are accepted.
request.notesPh: Details that help us serve you better
request.docsIntro: Upload clear photos or PDF files. Photos are compressed automatically to save your data.
request.docsPrivacy: Your documents are stored privately and only authorised Easy Visa staff can see them.
request.chooseFile: Choose a file or take a photo
request.fileTypes: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 8 MB
request.consent: I agree that Easy Visa may use these details to review my request and contact me, under the
request.draftRestored: We restored what you typed earlier on this device.
request.errorGeneric: We could not send your request. Check your connection and try again; it will not be sent twice.
request.errorFix: Please fix the fields marked in red.
request.unavailableTitle: This service is not accepting requests right now
request.unavailableText: Message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you what is available.
request.notice: This is a service request, not a confirmed booking. We confirm the details and price with you before anything is final.

success.title: We received your request
success.text: Keep your reference number. Our team will review your request and contact you.
success.next1: We review your details and documents.
success.next2: We contact you on WhatsApp or by phone to confirm the details and price.
success.next3: Check your request status any time on the tracking page.
success.screenshot: Tip: take a screenshot of this card for later.
success.saved: Saved to “My requests” on this device.

track.title: Track your request
track.intro: Enter your reference number and the last 4 digits of the phone number you used.
track.help: Can't find your reference? Message us on WhatsApp with your name and phone number.
track.privacy: To protect your data, documents and personal details are never shown here.

offers.title: Offers
offers.intro: Limited-time offers. Prices and availability are confirmed when you request.
offers.none: There are no current offers. Follow us on Instagram to hear about the next ones.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: For any question about visas or bookings, message or call us directly.
contact.formText: Want a detailed visa or travel consultation?

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may have changed. Start from the homepage or choose a service.

trips.title: Available trips
trips.intro: Scheduled departures with limited seats. Book your seat and we confirm the details and payment with you.
trips.none: No trips available in this section right now. Message us to hear about upcoming ones.
trips.seatsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No seats left} one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
trips.fullText: This trip is full. Message us to join the waiting list or get another option.
trips.bookNote: Your booking is provisional until we confirm it with you and payment is complete.

pay.title: Payment
pay.cardText: You will go to a secure payment page. We never take card details on our site.
pay.bankText: Send the amount to one of these accounts, then upload a photo of the receipt.
pay.cashText: You can pay in cash at our office in Mukalla. Mention your reference when paying.
pay.reportTitle: Sent the transfer? Confirm it here
pay.sent: We received your proof of payment. We will check it and update your request.

my.title: My requests
my.intro: Requests saved on this device only. No account or password needed.
my.empty: No requests are saved on this device yet. They appear here automatically after you send one.
my.notFound: We could not find this request.
my.privacy: References and the last 4 digits of your phone are stored in your browser only. You can remove them any time.

contactForm.title: Send a message
contactForm.text: Ask about anything: a visa, a booking, a trip, a payment, or feedback. We reply on WhatsApp or by phone.
contactForm.name: Name
contactForm.subject: Subject
contactForm.consent: I agree that Easy Visa may contact me about my message.
contactForm.sent: Your message arrived. We will reply soon.
contactForm.error: We could not send it. Try again or message us on WhatsApp.
